name: Civil Aviation Authority of Nepal (CAAN)
role: Primary technical regulator for civil aviation safety, registration, licensing, and flight authorizations.

name: Ministry of Home Affairs (MoHA)
role: National security screening, border restriction policies, and central UAV Working Procedure operations.

name: Department of National Parks and Wildlife Conservation (DNPWC)
role: Issuance of flight approvals inside national parks and wild protected habitats.

name: Department of Archaeology (DoA)
role: Clearance for aerial photography or operations near registered cultural monuments and UNESCO heritage landmarks.

name: District Administration Office (DAO)
role: Local security review and flight authorization coordination for operations up to 200 ft AGL.

name: Nepal Police
role: Enforcement of restricted airspace, drone seizure, and public compliance monitoring.

name: Nepal Army
role: Military airspace management, border surveillance, and liaison support during emergency disaster response authorizations.

name: Department of Customs
role: Import inspections, tariff duty collection, and issuance of customs clearance declarations for registration.
